mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lingxing_product_unified ( id, asin, parent_asin, base_sku, base_msku, base_store, country, developer, principal, title, listing_tags, product_create_time, fba_first_available_month, fba_first_available_basis, listing_open_date, model_start_month, model_start_basis, fba_inventory_first_month, inventory_first_store, inventory_first_country, inventory_first_sku, inventory_first_qty, available_first_store, available_first_country, available_first_sku, available_first_qty, fba_observation_status, total_volume, total_amount, total_order_items, total_gross_profit, avg_gross_margin, active_months, first_sale_month, last_sale_month, latest_month, latest_volume, latest_amount, latest_fba_available, latest_cate_rank, latest_avg_star, latest_reviews_count, data_cutoff_month, unified_version, synced_at ) WITH -- 准入铁律：仅 6 个目标标签 ID（周表 tag_ids 逗号分隔，FIND_IN_SET 精确匹配），以该 asin 最新周为准： -- 907563170455592213 欧洲精铺2025 / 907654877317203632 非标品 / 907585631391968576 淘汰 -- 907585847123066054 待淘汰 / 907596133278666918 季节性断货 / 907657425150046095 绿标 -- 排除 907677931879515735 侵权下架、普通产品、新品、淘汰产品、需确认 等。 latest_tag AS ( SELECT w.asin, w.tag_ids FROM lingxing_sku_weekly_performance w INNER JOIN ( SELECT asin, MAX(week_end) AS mx FROM lingxing_sku_weekly_performance WHERE asin IS NOT NULL AND asin != '' GROUP BY asin ) m ON m.asin = w.asin AND m.mx = w.week_end GROUP BY w.asin, w.tag_ids ), target_asins AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lt.asin FROM latest_tag lt WHERE lt.tag_ids IS NOT NULL AND lt.tag_ids != '' AND ( FIND_IN_SET('907563170455592213', lt.tag_ids) OR FIND_IN_SET('907654877317203632', lt.tag_ids) OR FIND_IN_SET('907585631391968576', lt.tag_ids) OR FIND_IN_SET('907585847123066054', lt.tag_ids) OR FIND_IN_SET('907596133278666918', lt.tag_ids) OR FIND_IN_SET('907657425150046095', lt.tag_ids) ) ), -- 周表按 asin 聚合（仅目标标签） agg AS ( SELECT w.asin, SUM(w.volume) AS total_volume, SUM(w.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(w.order_items) AS total_order_items, SUM(w.gross_profit) AS total_gross_profit, AVG(w.gross_margin) AS avg_gross_margin, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.volume > 0 THEN w.`year_month` END) AS active_months, MIN(CASE WHEN w.volume > 0 THEN w.`year_month` END) AS first_sale_month, MAX(CASE WHEN w.volume > 0 THEN w.`year_month` END) AS last_sale_month, MAX(w.`year_month`) AS latest_month, MAX(w.week_end) AS latest_week_end FROM lingxing_sku_weekly_performance w INNER JOIN target_asins t ON t.asin = w.asin WHERE w.asin IS NOT NULL AND w.asin != '' GROUP BY w.asin ), -- 最近一周快照 latest AS ( SELECT w.asin, SUM(w.volume) AS latest_volume, SUM(w.amount) AS latest_amount, SUM(w.afn_fulfillable_quantity) AS latest_fba_available, MAX(w.avg_star) AS latest_avg_star, MAX(w.reviews_count) AS latest_reviews_count, MAX(w.parent_asin) AS parent_asin, MAX(w.sku) AS base_msku, MAX(w.store_name) AS store_name, MAX(w.marketplace) AS country, MAX(w.product_name) AS title FROM lingxing_sku_weekly_performance w INNER JOIN agg ON agg.asin = w.asin AND agg.latest_week_end = w.week_end GROUP BY w.asin ), -- FBA 库存首现（afn_fulfillable_quantity>0 或 fbm_quantity>0 或 stock_up_num>0 的最早一周） inv_ranked AS ( SELECT w.asin, w.`year_month` AS m, w.store_name, w.marketplace, w.sku, w.afn_fulfillable_quantity AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.asin ORDER BY w.week_start ASC) AS rn FROM lingxing_sku_weekly_performance w INNER JOIN target_asins t ON t.asin = w.asin WHERE COALESCE(w.afn_fulfillable_quantity,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(w.fbm_quantity,0) > 0 OR COALESCE(w.stock_up_num,0) > 0 ), inv_first AS ( SELECT asin, m AS inv_month, store_name AS inv_store, marketplace AS inv_country, sku AS inv_sku, qty AS inv_qty FROM inv_ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), -- FBA 可售首现（afn_fulfillable_quantity>0 的最早一周） avl_ranked AS ( SELECT w.asin, w.`year_month` AS m, w.store_name, w.marketplace, w.sku, w.afn_fulfillable_quantity AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.asin ORDER BY w.week_start ASC) AS rn FROM lingxing_sku_weekly_performance w INNER JOIN target_asins t ON t.asin = w.asin WHERE COALESCE(w.afn_fulfillable_quantity,0) > 0 ), avl_first AS ( SELECT asin, m AS avl_month, store_name AS avl_store, marketplace AS avl_country, sku AS avl_sku, qty AS avl_qty FROM avl_ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), -- 真实上架日 lst AS ( SELECT asin, MIN(open_date) AS listing_open_date FROM lingxing_listing WHERE open_date IS NOT NULL AND asin IS NOT NULL AND asin != '' GROUP BY asin ) SELECT UUID_SHORT(), t.asin, latest.parent_asin, b.base_sku, latest.base_msku, COALESCE(b.base_store, latest.store_name), latest.country, b.developer, NULL, latest.title, b.listing_tags, COALESCE(b.product_create_time, ''), -- FBA 可售首现月：周表算的优先，无则回退 baseline COALESCE(avl_first.avl_month, b.fba_available_first_month_final), CASE WHEN avl_first.avl_month IS NOT NULL THEN '周表首次观察到FBA可售' ELSE b.fba_available_first_basis END, lst.listing_open_date, -- 起算月：可售首现月优先，无则库存首现月，再无回退 baseline COALESCE(avl_first.avl_month, inv_first.inv_month, b.model_start_month), CASE WHEN avl_first.avl_month IS NOT NULL THEN '周表FBA可售首现' WHEN inv_first.inv_month IS NOT NULL THEN '周表FBA库存首现' ELSE b.model_start_basis END, inv_first.inv_month, inv_first.inv_store, inv_first.inv_country, inv_first.inv_sku, inv_first.inv_qty, avl_first.avl_store, avl_first.avl_country, avl_first.avl_sku, avl_first.avl_qty, CASE WHEN inv_first.inv_month IS NOT NULL THEN '已观察到FBA库存' ELSE '周表未观察到FBA库存' END, COALESCE(agg.total_volume, 0), COALESCE(agg.total_amount, 0), COALESCE(agg.total_order_items, 0), COALESCE(agg.total_gross_profit, 0), agg.avg_gross_margin, COALESCE(agg.active_months, 0), agg.first_sale_month, agg.last_sale_month, agg.latest_month, latest.latest_volume, latest.latest_amount, latest.latest_fba_available, NULL, latest.latest_avg_star, latest.latest_reviews_count, #{cutoffMonth}, #{unifiedVersion}, NOW() FROM target_asins t LEFT JOIN agg ON agg.asin = t.asin LEFT JOIN latest ON latest.asin = t.asin LEFT JOIN inv_first ON inv_first.asin = t.asin LEFT JOIN avl_first ON avl_first.asin = t.asin LEFT JOIN lingxing_asin_baseline b ON b.asin = t.asin LEFT JOIN lst ON lst.asin = t.asin ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_asin = VALUES(parent_asin), base_sku = VALUES(base_sku), base_msku = VALUES(base_msku), base_store = VALUES(base_store), country = VALUES(country), developer = VALUES(developer), title = VALUES(title), listing_tags = VALUES(listing_tags), product_create_time = VALUES(product_create_time), fba_first_available_month = VALUES(fba_first_available_month), fba_first_available_basis = VALUES(fba_first_available_basis), listing_open_date = VALUES(listing_open_date), model_start_month = VALUES(model_start_month), model_start_basis = VALUES(model_start_basis), fba_inventory_first_month = VALUES(fba_inventory_first_month), inventory_first_store = VALUES(inventory_first_store), inventory_first_country = VALUES(inventory_first_country), inventory_first_sku = VALUES(inventory_first_sku), inventory_first_qty = VALUES(inventory_first_qty), available_first_store = VALUES(available_first_store), available_first_country = VALUES(available_first_country), available_first_sku = VALUES(available_first_sku), available_first_qty = VALUES(available_first_qty), fba_observation_status = VALUES(fba_observation_status), total_volume = VALUES(total_volume), total_amount = VALUES(total_amount), total_order_items = VALUES(total_order_items), total_gross_profit = VALUES(total_gross_profit), avg_gross_margin = VALUES(avg_gross_margin), active_months = VALUES(active_months), first_sale_month = VALUES(first_sale_month), last_sale_month = VALUES(last_sale_month), latest_month = VALUES(latest_month), latest_volume = VALUES(latest_volume), latest_amount = VALUES(latest_amount), latest_fba_available = VALUES(latest_fba_available), latest_avg_star = VALUES(latest_avg_star), latest_reviews_count = VALUES(latest_reviews_count), data_cutoff_month = VALUES(data_cutoff_month), unified_version = VALUES(unified_version), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at)
